intro: Baskin-Robbins is the ice cream chain famous for its '31 flavors', one for every day of the month, served as scoops, sundaes, milkshakes and the signature Cappuccino Blast. Beyond the scoop case it is a go-to for ice cream cakes and the shareable Polar Pizza ice cream treat. Below is the full Baskin-Robbins menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Baskin-Robbins, a single scoop runs about $4.98 to $7.36, a double scoop $6.86 to $11.86, a two-scoop sundae $8.73 to $13.73, and a milkshake $7.86 to $11.61 (prices vary a lot by location). A 6-inch ice cream cake is about $38.99 to $44.99 and a Polar Pizza is $25.99. The 31 flavors and the Cappuccino Blast are the icons.
hot_deal: Baskin-Robbins value: the app and Birthday Club drop a free scoop on your birthday and regular deals, and 'Celebrate 31' days often mean discounted scoops. A pre-packed quart ($9.09) is the cheapest way to take ice cream home. Scoop prices vary a lot by location, so the app shows your store's pricing.

faqs.q: How much is a scoop at Baskin-Robbins?
faqs.a: A single scoop runs about $4.98 to $7.36 and a double scoop $6.86 to $11.86, but scoop prices vary a lot by location. A waffle cone is an upgrade. The app shows your store's exact pricing and often has deals.

faqs.q: How much is a Baskin-Robbins ice cream cake?
faqs.a: A 6-inch round cake is about $38.99 to $44.99 (serves 6 to 8), a 9-inch is $51.99 to $62.99, and full sheet cakes run $51.99 to $63.99. The shareable Polar Pizza ice cream treat is $25.99 and serves about 8.

faqs.q: What are the 31 flavors at Baskin-Robbins?
faqs.a: The '31 flavors' is the brand's idea of one flavor for every day of the month. The lineup rotates and includes classics like Very Berry Strawberry, Pralines 'n Cream, Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough, Mint Chocolate Chip and the Flavor of the Month, so the exact 31 change over time.

faqs.q: How many calories are in Baskin-Robbins ice cream?
faqs.a: It depends entirely on the flavor and size, so no single figure applies, which is why calories are left blank here. Baskin-Robbins publishes nutrition per flavor in store and on its app; for reference, the fresh-baked waffle cone alone is about 130 calories.

The Cappuccino Blast is Baskin-Robbins' signature blended drink, made with coffee and ice cream blended into a cold, frosty coffee treat, often topped with whipped cream. It comes in several flavors and is one of the chain's best-known items.
